data: Apple was the larger of the two in fiscal 2024. Apple reported total net sales of about $391.0 billion for fiscal 2024, which ended September 28, 2024, up roughly 2% from $383.3 billion in fiscal 2023. Microsoft reported total revenue of about $245.1 billion for fiscal 2024, which ended June 30, 2024, up roughly 16% from $211.9 billion in fiscal 2023. Apple's revenue was therefore about 1.6 times Microsoft's, a gap of roughly $146 billion. The two fiscal years end about three months apart, so the periods do not line up exactly. Microsoft was growing considerably faster over the year.
